title: The full GPT forward pass and loss
hints: Embeddings: x = wte[tokens] + wpe[:T]; the positional rows broadcast over the batch.
Loop over params['blocks'] with causal_mask(T) and params['n_heads'], then apply the final LayerNorm with lnf_g and lnf_b.

Tied output projection: logits = x @ wte.T. For the loss, compute a stable log-softmax (subtract the max, then z - log(sum(exp(z)))), pick the target entries with np.take_along_axis and average over every position.
